claim_ceiling: Candidate target policy and finite model-local controls. No actual source-owner acceptance, universal theorem, semantic admission or execution authority.
coupling_rule: Named forbidden implications and permitted recorded axis couplings remain distinct; independence never automatically demands all Cartesian combinations.
distinction_rule: Permitted differences need a witness; all-model differences need an independently checked universal target under non-vacuous premises.
population_rule: One required, explicitly exempt or unresolved policy for each exact carrier/predicate endpoint. Required populations coexist in one model; exemptions require exact review evidence and unresolved policies remain blockers.
supported_alignment: Exact recorded identity shared-carrier only; nominal labels alone never align carriers.
